nodes.description: Token name string state variable, set to 'KoshkaMinu' in the constructor.
Token symbol string state variable, set to 'KIMU' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, initialized in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of address to token balance; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; written in approve and transferFrom.
KoshkaMinu constructor: sets metadata, mints total supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
ERC20 totalSupply view function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
ERC20 balanceOf view function returning balances for a given token owner.
ERC20 allowance view function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no return-value check on callers.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using the allowance of msg.sender; allowance is deducted without checking the return of approve.
SafeMath addition with overflow require check (c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction with underflow require check (b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication with overflow require check.
SafeMath division with division-by-zero require check.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner and allowance owner throughout the contract.
State write balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply during construction (mint).
State write allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens in approve, gated only by msg.sender identity.
State write balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) in transfer.
State write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer.
State write balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) in transferFrom.
State write allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) in transferFrom.
State write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transferFrom.
Arithmetic c = a + b in safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic c = a - b in safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic c = a * b in safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic c = a / b in safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf used as mapping key.
tokenOwner parameter of allowance used as outer mapping key.
spender parameter of allowance used as inner mapping key.
spender parameter of approve used as inner allowance key.
tokens parameter of approve written into the allowed mapping.
to parameter of transfer used as receiver balance key.
tokens parameter of transfer subtracted and added to balances.
from parameter of transferFrom used as source balance key.
to parameter of transferFrom used as receiver balance key.
tokens parameter of transferFrom subtracted from balance and allowance.

First operand a of safeMul.
Second operand b of safeMul.

Second operand b (denominator) of safeDiv.
Local result variable c returned by safeAdd.

Local result variable c returned by safeMul.
Local result variable c returned by safeDiv.
